compiler_provenance: artifact-build-epoch; immutable native runner statically contains runtime
methodology: Single thread, 150 ms warmup; 11 in-process single-call samples; process startup and compilation excluded. Every result checked against independent cc -O2 C reference. Symmetric 1.5×IQR inclusive interpolated quartiles; raw samples and excluded indices retained. Binary trees include allocation and reclamation (Go GC). Mandelbrot and FASTA digest output bytes without I/O; floats rounded to nine decimals. Host gate: every measured job runs pinned (inherited affinity, no wrapper) to one logical CPU of the quietest core, chosen again before each attempt once its other hyperthread has settled, and is repeated unless that CPU kept its clock within 3% of the job median (10th to 90th percentile), the median reached 95% of the clock calibrated at start, and the hyperthread sibling was busy at most 15% of the job; Go runs with GOMAXPROCS=1 on that CPU. Rejected attempts are retained with their observations.
